# Announcements

## Purpose

Admins post short announcements, such as planned maintenance or a new feature, and every signed-in user of the tenant sees the newest one on the home page.

## Requirements

- **Post.** An admin posts an announcement with a title (required, up to 120 characters) and a body (required, up to 1000 characters), and optionally a date it expires on.
  - When an admin posts "Maintenance on Friday", it is listed first on the Announcements page.
- **Show.** The home page shows the newest announcement that hasn't expired to every signed-in user of the same tenant.
  - When the newest announcement expired yesterday, the home page shows the one before it, or nothing.
- **Delete.** An admin deletes an announcement, and it no longer shows anywhere.
- **Access.** Only users with the announcements permission see the Announcements page or call its API.

## Decisions

- **Per tenant.** Each tenant has its own announcements, like the rest of its data.
- **No editing.** An announcement is deleted and posted again instead of edited, to keep the first version small.

# Announcements

Track: full. The user approved this plan.

## Specs

- Adds `specs/announcements.md`.

## Design

- `Announcement` entity in Server.Api (Id, Title, Body, PublishedOn, ExpiresOn, Version), tenant-aware like the rest of the data, with its EF Core configuration and a migration.
- `AnnouncementDto` in Shared, and `IAnnouncementController` with a list (OData), create and delete.
- An Announcements page under Management with a grid and an add modal, and a banner component on the home page.
- A new `Announcements_Manage` permission in the Management group of `AppFeatures`.

## Tasks

- [x] 1. Spec and plan
- [x] 2. `AnnouncementDto` and its `AppJsonContext` registration
- [ ] 3. `Announcement` entity, its configuration, the `DbSet` and the migration
- [ ] 4. Mapper, `IAnnouncementController` and `AnnouncementController`
- [ ] 5. The Announcements page, the home banner, the permission, navigation and tests

## Changes to the plan

- None yet.
